Starn directs Stone to White; examples and methodological limits are explicit. Broad historiographical diagnoses, dismissive descriptions and implied psychologies remain Stone’s claims. revival.people: Added Cipolla, Thomas, Brown, Zeldin and Gossman as shared people; selected these and Starn, Duby, Ginzburg, Davis and Darnton with specifically attributed contexts. Brown is a comparison because Stone explicitly denies that his portrait is narrative; named examples are not endorsements of Stone.
revival.works_and_arguments: Read Stone printed 3–6 and 13–24, with OCR/visual recovery of clipped text; Hobsbawm’s complete 1980 reply and the earlier Tuchman/Fox-Genovese exchange retain their recorded scopes. Works distinguish narrative, case argument, cultural portrait and book history, and Davis’s forthcoming citation remains forthcoming as of 1979.
revival.internal_distinctions: Six additional distinctions cover the limited trend diagnosis, story/argument, scale, cultural forms, selection/typicality and continuing narrative readership. Stone’s explicit qualifications accompany his polemical claims rather than treating either as a consensus.
revival.incoming_connections: Four specifically evidenced incoming contributions: Starn’s recommendation of White in Stone note 2, Geertz’s cockfight example, Elias reception and the contextual work of Pocock/Skinner/Bailyn. A cited resource is not a founding relationship or shared programme.
revival.outgoing_connections: Existing quantitative critique qualified by Stone’s rejection of genre monopoly and acknowledgment of continued analytical work. Micro/cultural contributions identified as contemporary readings of earlier research, not its origin. White and Tuchman comparisons preserve different projects and chronology.
revival.evidence_and_interpretation: Stone upgraded from metadata to selected-primary support, with exact pages read/unread, recovery method, and edition/reception claims not certified. Existing IDs, qualifications, original prose and directions preserved; Hobsbawm’s disagreement and Fox-Genovese’s criticism remain explicit.
